nodes.label: Rationale: Automating Manual Vercel Deploy
nodes.rationale: Automates what had been a manual `vercel --prod` deploy — a push to production touching dashboard/** now deploys itself rather than relying on someone remembering to run the CLI. VERCEL_ORG_ID/VERCEL_PROJECT_ID are not secret (plain project identifiers already visible in dashboard/.vercel/project.json, gitignored per-machine) but are passed as repo secrets anyway so the workflow avoids hardcoding them.

nodes.label: Rationale: Immediate Analyzer Trigger via /fire Endpoint Supersedes Cron Timing
nodes.rationale: The cron nominally runs at 07:30 UTC but GitHub Actions' scheduling delay means it actually fires anywhere from ~08:00 to ~12:00 UTC in practice, so it should not be relied on to line up with the analyzer routine's 08:00 UTC daily cron. This is no longer load-bearing anyway: collect fires the analyzer routine immediately via its /fire endpoint right after queuing analysis requests (see triggerAnalyzerRoutine in cmd/collect.go) — the routine's own daily cron is now just a fallback in case the immediate trigger fails. If ROUTINE_TRIGGER_TOKEN isn't set, collect just logs a note and continues; the routine's daily schedule still eventually picks up the work.
